criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 273 identifies PHYS at 525 Northwestern Avenue. Independently reopened mesh 'PHYS | GIS footprint brick envelope' has a bidirectional maximum nearest-vertex deviation of 0.00000054 m from the 33-vertex GIS ring after the project transform; the ring and its projection reconciliation are documented in the evidence record.
criteria.limitation: The local WGS84-to-meter transform is approximate, not a surveyed CRS.

criteria.evidence: The master file reopened without saving. Placement_physics_building instances Asset_physics_building from the expected linked asset path. Its location [20.73237228, 300.32412720, 0] m differs from the GIS-derived manifest origin [20.732372, 300.324127] by 0.00000035 m; scale is one and rotation is zero. The reloaded master collection contains the current 319 objects. The source footprint orientation is unchanged and verified against the GIS ring.
criteria.limitation: The GIS transform itself is project-local approximate positioning, not survey-grade georeferencing.

criteria.criterion: Supported floors, height, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS F01/F02/F03 values (13, 27.1, 40.15 ft) and R=52.25 ft support the three principal story datums and approximate roof datum used by the model; the three-story red-brick facade and red tiled roof are visible in Purdue photos. R2 retains this approximately three-story form and applies a red tile surface with eaves/ridge treatment.
criteria.limitation: GIS NUM_LEVELS=8 and Extrution=84 conflict with the F-level fields and photos. The source has no section/elevation confirming exact wall height, roof pitch, roof thickness, or basement dimensions; the asset top is about 0.17 m above the nominal 52.25 ft roof datum.

criteria.criterion: Facade, main entrance, and distinctive features
criteria.evidence: R2 improves the NW Avenue frontage with taller divided sash assemblies, running-bond brick, pale story bands, projecting eave/cornice, and a clearer central light-stone PHYSICS sign and three glazed entry bays. The refreshed exterior and entry renders show a sidewalk, curb, roadway, lawn, low hedge, and fence as review-only context. A GIS-aligned glazed skybridge and secondary arched entrance are represented; Purdue photos support the broad architectural language.
criteria.limitation: Window counts and spacing, entrance measurements, basement sash, roof profile and much of the facade detailing remain estimates. The simple window groups and three-door composition still do not reproduce the finer frame, masonry, banner, and corner details visible in the references.

criteria.criterion: Materials, interior, modular export, and evidence
criteria.evidence: A fresh Blender 5.2.3 reopen found 319 collection objects and 317 meshes; the exact manifest object list/count and all local bounds agree, every mesh has materials, there are no missing external image dependencies, and procedural Brick Texture nodes are present in masonry/roof materials. The master link reloads the same 319-object collection. R2 adds ground/first/second level plates and separate schematic corridor/room partitions guided by Purdue evacuation-plan functions, and new cutaway/ground-plan previews.
criteria.limitation: Interior plans and partition placement are schematic; room dimensions and detailed uses are not modeled as-built, and interiors remain sparse compared with the exterior. Bridge span/elevation and roof form also remain partly interpretive.
